Initial release of Workopia — Jobs, Resumes & Career Advice.

- Search for jobs directly from employer career pages, with filtering by role, company, location, or remote.
- Build or improve resumes with six professional templates, and generate downloadable PDF resumes.
- Get career advice, skill gap analysis, and guidance on transitions or job paths.
- No login, API key, or subscription required; free to use.
